title: BNP Paribas: Excess lowering
description: The banking sector is under pressure from central banks, in a context of sustainable low interest rate. But after a downward phase during the month of May, a delay zone seems to have been found. From a graphic point of view, BNP Paribas rushed and then reinstated the support at 40.45 EUR, close to the major support at 39.60 EUR. An extended triangle of reversal is now defined: the prices should join the high terminal of the figure, close to the resistance at 42.55 EUR. The overflowing of this obstacle would allow a more ambitious increase towards resistors at 44.59 EUR then 45.95EUR, a major level. A fence under 39.60 EUR would reject this anticipation.    - Subscribe to our channel: https://www.youtube.com/igfrance?sub_Confirmation=1  - More info on: https://www.ig.com/fr    Twitter: https://twitter.com/igfrance  Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/igfrance  Linkedin: https://www.linkedin.com/company/ig-france    --------------------------------------------------------------------------------    CFDs are complex instruments and have a high risk of rapid capital loss due to the leverage.  76% of private investor accounts lose money when they invest in CFDs with IG*.
